Judy Marks will retire as chair, chief executive officer, and president upon the appointment of her successor, which is expected in the first half of 2027.
Otis board has launched a CEO search with Spencer Stuart advising the process. The search will consider both internal and external candidates, overseen by independent directors.
Marks will remain in her current role through July 31, 2027, or serve as senior adviser if a successor is named sooner.

title: Otis CEO Judy Marks to retire in 1H 2027
